OhGeesy, whose real name is Alejandro Coranza, is a Los Angeles rapper and one of the founding members of the West Coast hip-hop group Shoreline Mafia. Born and raised in Los Angeles, OhGeesy rose to fame alongside Fenix Flexin through viral tracks like “Musty,” “Nun Major,” and “Bottle Service.” Known for his signature flow, catchy hooks, and West Coast sound, OhGeesy has established himself as one of the most recognizable figures in California’s rap scene. Beyond Shoreline Mafia, he has built a successful solo career, releasing projects, collaborating with major artists, and performing at festivals and sold-out shows across the country. 

Fenix Flexin is a Los Angeles rapper best known as one of the founding members of Shoreline Mafia alongside OhGeesy. He gained recognition during the group’s rise in the late 2010s, helping popularize their distinctive West Coast sound through viral music videos, catchy flows, and street-inspired lyrics. Following Shoreline Mafia’s initial split, Fenix pursued a solo career, releasing multiple projects and building a dedicated fan base. Known for his laid-back delivery, unique style, and influence on California’s underground rap scene, Fenix remains an important figure in the West Coast hip-hop movement.

Cr*p Mac, also known as C-Mac, is a Los Angeles internet personality, rapper, and viral social media figure who gained widespread recognition through his outspoken personality, distinctive slang, and entertaining interviews.
